name: DualSlider
description: A dual-handle slider component for selecting a range with minimum and maximum values
usage: Use for selecting a range between two values (e.g., price ranges, date ranges)
Provide clear labels to indicate what the range controls
Use minLabel and maxLabel to differentiate between the two sliders
Consider using valueFormatter to display the range in a user-friendly format
Ensure minValue cannot exceed maxValue through external validation if needed
examples:
<DualSlider
  label="Date Range"
  minValue={startYear}
  maxValue={endYear}
  min={1900}
  max={2023}
  onMinChange={setStartYear}
  onMaxChange={setEndYear}
  minLabel="From"
  maxLabel="To"
  valueFormatter={(min, max) => `${min} to ${max}`}
/>
design: Slider track uses var(--color-surface-1) for consistent theming
Slider thumb/active area uses var(--color-primary) accent color
Text uses var(--color-text-default) for label and var(--color-text-muted) for value and slider labels
Two sliders are displayed in a grid-cols-2 layout with gap-4
Each slider has its own label (minLabel/maxLabel) displayed in xs text above it
Default height is h-2 (0.5rem) with rounded-lg corners

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label text displayed above the slider pair

props.name: onMinChange
props.description: Minimum value change handler called when the min slider value changes (required)

props.name: onMaxChange
props.description: Maximum value change handler called when the max slider value changes (required)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container element

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the main label element

props.name: valueClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the value display element

props.name: sliderClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for both slider input elements

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether to show the current value range next to the label

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Function to format the displayed value range
